title.zh: 将高山省 Bauko 市镇 Mayag 描笼涯的 Guinzadan 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Mayag 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Guinzadan National High School - Mayag Extension in Barangay Mayag, Municipality of Bauko, Mountain Province From the Guinzadan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Mayag National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Mayag của Trường Trung học Guinzadan Quốc gia tại Barangay Mayag, Đô thị Bauko, Tỉnh Mountain Province khỏi Trường Trung học Guinzadan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Mayag Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Mayag ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guinzadan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Mayag เทศบาล Bauko จังหวัด Mountain Province ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guinzadan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mayag แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Mayag, Sekolah Menengah Guinzadan Nasional di Barangay Mayag, Kotamadya Bauko, Provinsi Mountain Province dari Sekolah Menengah Guinzadan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Mayag Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana

text.en: The Guinzadan National High School - Mayag Extension in Barangay Mayag, Municipality of Bauko, Mountain Province is hereby separated from the Guinzadan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Mayag National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Guinzadan National High School - Mayag Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Mayag National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Mayag National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Guinzadan National High School - Mayag Extension. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within one hundred twenty (120) days after the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
